archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for Clinical Trust

typography.installation: Ensure Google Fonts Manrope and IBM Plex Sans are imported. They provide excellent Cyrillic support required for Bulgarian.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-extrabold text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 or p-12 for bento grid containers. Clinical precision requires whitespace.
spacing_and_layout.storefront_grid: Use Mode A (The 'Tetris' Grid) for collections and scientific articles sections. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.admin_grid: Use Mode B (The 'Control Room' Grid) for the admin dashboard. Tight gap-4, high density data correlation.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px border-slate-200, no shadow by default, hover:shadow-md transition-shadow.

components.button_primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-3 border border-transparent text-base font-medium rounded-md text-white bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-colors
components.button_secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-3 border border-slate-300 text-base font-medium rounded-md text-slate-700 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-colors
components.input: block w-full border-slate-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 sm:text-sm p-3 border
components.badge: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-blue-100 text-blue-800
components.header: Solid white bg-white border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-50

hero_background.description: Clear glass test tubes. Use for hero or scientific banner with a white/20 gradient overlay for text readability.

storefront_specifics.hero_section: White background with a subtle grid or lab imagery overlay. Very clean, authoritative. 'Лиофилизираните пептиди са златен стандарт за качество... Тествани от Janoshik Labs.' Text aligned left, large H1.
storefront_specifics.usp_row: Flex row of 3 icons (delivery, payment, quality) with short bold text below them. Center aligned, high trust.
storefront_specifics.product_card: Minimalist card. Product image on crisp white. Title in Manrope font. Price in EUR (with BGN in small muted text). Primary CTA 'Add to cart' appears on hover.
storefront_specifics.calculator: Peptide concentration calculator section: clean bento card with input sliders or fields, returning strict calculated text. Medical styling.
storefront_specifics.currency: All prices must primarily show EUR, with equivalent BGN next to it or underneath.

admin_specifics.layout: Sidebar navigation (Products, Collections, Customers, Orders, Settings, Import). Main content area uses Shadcn tables and cards.
admin_specifics.dashboard_stats: Control Room grid. Cards showing Total Sales, Awaiting Payment, Pending Shipments.
admin_specifics.theme: Keep it Light mode to match storefront clinical vibe, but with higher density.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.
Ensure the application strictly uses pure white and slate-50 for backgrounds to maintain a clinical, sanitary laboratory feel.
Implement the USP icons and product images exactly as provided in the 'images' dictionary (which were extracted directly from the live purepeptide.bg site).
Build the storefront in Bulgarian (Cyrillic) as the primary language.
Use Shadcn UI primitives but override their default borders and radii to match the 1px sharp medical aesthetic.
Do NOT use any purple or teal gradients anywhere in the app.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
